notes.title: Blitzstrike - Fan Service (Literally) - Hotfix
notes.notes:
https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3654000/extras/BSLogo.png?t=1750986639

Hey Blitzstrike fans!

Blitzstrike has received fantastic feedback, but one fan pointed out a small issue about the... well, fans. It was tricky to tell the strength of them. Were they strong? Weak? It was just a fantasy-level guess. 

So I made it crystal clear:
The speed of the particles emitted reflect the actual force of the fan! Now you'll know exactly how much lift to expect- no more surprise skydives. Trixel was not a fan of those.

It's a fancy little fix for our fanatics out there. Now everything just feels a bit more fantastically satisfying.

Okay, I'll stop. Thanks for playing.

-Brennan

notes.title: 1.1.1 - Bug Fixes + Maintenance
notes.notes:
https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3654000/extras/BSLogo.png?t=1750986639

Hey Blitzstrike fans!

Some minor bug fixes have been included into Blitzstrike v1.1.1, providing a smoother gameplay experience. If you're curious, here's an abridged list.


Trixel and the Commander would sometimes appear invisible in the cutscene preceding Meet Trixel!
The credits can be skipped like any other cutscene now, by pressing ESC or START, depending on what controls you are using.
In You Knew This Was Coming, in rare cases, Vectoria would stand there... and do nothing. Sometimes thats even more scary.


Thats all. As thanks for reading this post and loving Blitzstrike, here's Trixel chilling with a cat. 

https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/1179608276904710144/1383955465280553071/pixil-frame-0-641_scaled_10x_pngcrushed.png?ex=6867beb7&is=68666d37&hm=9c4b4ec0baa36fbc4763a0f8bfa1bfe0de0ca6da2520a327f186b1f84179e242&=&format=webp&quality=lossless&width=820&height=1300

-Brennan

notes.title: Blitzstrike - Day TWO Patch
notes.notes:
You've heard of a Day One patch, bet you've never heard of a day TWO patch!

In addition to small minor internal fixes, some noticeable changes are:

 
Volume is saved alongside accessibility options, so you don't get jumpscared with a loud Blitzstrike beep every launch.
Fixed a softlock on Level 9. Vectoria slipped that one in there last second.

More changes are coming in the future, so stay tuned!

-Brennan
